method.name: ancestry_order
method.description: Answers [param routes] with every route after its parent. [param parents] maps a route to its parent route, or to [code]0[/code] where it anchors nothing.

method.name: reconcile
method.description: Plans [param peers] against [param rows], which arrive in parent-before-child book order. Each row is [code]{route, parent_route, recipients, local_desired, leave}[/code] and each operation is [code]{action, route, peer}[/code], plus [code]{decision, forced}[/code] when the action is a loss.
